name: Villarmayor (Spain)
description: Red field with a white triangle with its base along the fly and its apex at the hoist, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villarmayor (a tree and a bell on red above a bridge on green).
history: Municipal flag of Villarmayor; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
